name: Analogue Apotik
about: Analogue Apotik is a Malaysian fragrance and grooming brand founded in Kuala Lumpur in 2015 by Adrian Cheong. It began as The Apothecary, making portable handcrafted solid colognes, and now sells each of its scents as an alcohol-free Oil de Parfum and as a solid cologne. It has shops in Damansara Uptown and Kuala Lumpur.
